highlights: Staff trained in international child protection procedures
Early concern reporting and wellbeing-focused community
safety.policy_summary: Middleton International School Bangkok maintains a robust child safeguarding framework overseen by a Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL). All staff members undergo international child protection training to ensure early identification, careful listening, and appropriate response to any welfare concerns, fostering a secure environment inspired by the Reggio Emilia and EtonHouse values.
